newsitem.title: HUNGARY: New Zalakeramia shares to trade on June 6.
newsitem.headline: New Zalakeramia shares to trade on June 6.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange said on Wednesday it would introduce 1,042,800 Zalakeramia Rt shares, stemming from a recent capital increase, on June 6. The shares entitle for full 1997 dividend.

Tile maker Zalakeramia raised its 1.836 billion forint share capital by 1.042 billion forints by issuing new shares privately earlier this year, aimed at raising funds to finance acquisitions and expansion plans.
The company has implemented three acquisitions this year.

It has bought majority stakes in Croatia's Inker, Hungary's Pietra and under the latest deal, announced on Tuesday, it had signed an agreement with the Romanian State Ownership Fudn to acquire the Fund's 62 percent stake in S.C. Cesarom S.A, one of Romania's leading tile and sanitary ware producers.
On Tuesday Zalakeramia shares finished at 7,645 forints, up 245.
